plan: A jungle fighter who jumps from enemy to enemy: if he reaches a fight with his items, he can wipe a whole team.
aSurveiller: His R (Highlander). He runs very fast, ignores slows and every takedown extends it: don't face him alone at that moment.
contrer: Keep your stuns and knock-ups for after his Q: during that jump he is untargetable.
Stay grouped: alone, he beats you; against several crowd controls, he falls very fast.
When he meditates (W) he stands still and takes less damage: interrupt him with a stun instead of wasting damage.
forces: Very strong in the late game with his items.
His Q makes him untargetable and dodges many spells.
His R, extended with every takedown, lets him clean up a fight.
faiblesses: No crowd control: he can't stop you from using your spells.
Very fragile against stuns and knock-ups.
Weak at the very start of the game, he needs time to scale.

sorts.P: Every few attacks, he strikes twice.
sorts.Q: Jumps from enemy to enemy, untargetable during the jump.
sorts.W: Meditates: heals and reduces damage taken, but stays still.
sorts.E: His attacks deal bonus true damage.
sorts.R: Gains a lot of speed and ignores slows; extended with every takedown.

momentFort: Farms a lot early and rarely ganks. Invade him and take his camps: he becomes fearsome once he has his items.
